_comment: Real 3D people (Roadmap 2 S5). The shared crowd (src/entities/people/crowd.js) draws the people nearest to Shoumik with the rigged model assets/people/people.glb (tools/people-kit) instead of the code-built shapes; everyone further away, and everyone on Low, stays code-built. count = how many real people at once per quality (0 = off); distance = only people closer than this (metres) can be real; keepFactor = a real person stays real until this many times 'distance' (no flicker). assignSeconds = how often the nearest people are re-chosen. farUpdate = people further than this (metres) animate every 2nd frame. shadows = real people cast sun shadows on these qualities. textures = most painted clothing textures kept at once (each 256 px). paintPerFrame = new textures painted per frame. heightScale = model height (1.72 m) to the crowd's 1.76 m skeleton; modelHeight = the height the model was packed at (tools/people-kit/people.json). headScale = the Kenney head is big: shrink it. clips = clip for each movement and walk/run speeds of the clips (m/s, so feet do not slide); runFrom = faster than this uses the run clip. actions = clip for each Animator action (src/entities/people/animActions.js): loop = repeats, hold = stays on the last frame (lying down), variants = picked by the action's variant, speed = time scale, y = extra height (metres). carry = clips for people with a tray (hotel waiters); trayLift = tray above the middle of the hands. attach = sizes of hair, headscarves, caps, lungi / saree / kameez skirts and small items (metres or shares of the body, model space at the T-pose; see src/entities/people/real/attachments.js). colours = fixed colours (vest = police vest).
